 Location: Renton, WA 
 Duration: 1 + year 
 Interview: Phone and Skype

 · 3+ years working experience in BI development

 · 3-5 years working experience with relational database systems (e.g. SQL Server, MySQL, or Oracle) 
 · 2+ years working experience with ETL/ELT tools (e.g. AWS Data Pipeline or Lambda functions) 
 · Having good experience working on AWS? 
 · Having experience working with Redshift or snowflake (not schema design, but a tool by name snowflake 

 Graduation
